title: Sound Horeg Pak RT
mood: rowdy, sleepless and laughing about it
subject: a neighbourhood head's son testing a rented stack of sound-system speakers at two in the morning before a wedding, and the windows rattle until the whole alley comes out and dances
caption: DJ jedag-jedug remix in the Indonesian TikTok breakbeat style. A pumping detuned supersaw lead playing a short four-note riff; a booming 808 sub bass with a hard sidechain pump; a breakbeat drum loop with fast snare rolls into every chorus; live kendang koplo fills slapping between phrases; a thin whistling synth lead like a suling. Loud and brickwalled, huge sub, tinny top end like a rented street sound system. Male voice, a loud grinning tenor, half-shouting the verses and singing the chorus, a crowd shouting 'goyang' on the downbeats. 135 BPM, A minor. Rowdy, sleepless and laughing about it. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no slow ballad intro, no dubstep wobble, no English rap.
lyrics:
[Intro - supersaw riff and kendang fills]

[Verse 1]
Jam dua pagi, Ndaru anaknya Pak RT
Nyewa sound dua belas buat nikahan kakaknya besok
Cek satu dua, kaca jendela ikut gemeter
Kucing tetangga lompat ke genteng nggak balik lagi

[Pre-Chorus]
Bu Har buka pintu bawa sapu
Eh, kakinya malah ikut maju

[Chorus]
Jedag jedug, jedag jedug, satu gang nggak tidur
Jedag jedug, jedag jedug, goyang dulu, besok libur
Pak RT keluar pakai sarung mau marah
Tiga detik kemudian dia paling depan, goyang sarung

[Verse 2]
Jam tiga satpam kompleks ikut dateng
Senternya diputer-puter kayak lampu disko
Bayi di rumah ujung malah ketawa
Cuma mbah Darmo yang tidur, kupingnya udah kurang denger

[Pre-Chorus]
Ada yang lapor ke grup WA
Yang bales cuma stiker joget semua

[Chorus]
Jedag jedug, jedag jedug, satu gang nggak tidur
Jedag jedug, jedag jedug, goyang dulu, besok libur
Subuh dateng, Ndaru matiin kabelnya
Pak RT teriak, satu lagu lagi, nanggung

[Outro - kendang koplo and sub bass fade]
Besok nikahannya, kita semua ngantuk
Tapi goyangnya udah hafal duluan
